A1.justification: Both complete 21-page PDFs describe VRBench. Their main text, tables, figures, and supplementary material support comparison; appendix renumbering does not indicate missing content.

before.justification: v1 reports original model evaluations in Table 2, human-judge alignment experiments in Figure 4, and test-time scaling experiments in Figure 5.

after.justification: v2 reports revised and expanded model evaluations in Table 2 and retains the original human-alignment and test-time scaling experiments.

M1.justification: The annotation pipeline, two-phase model evaluation, DeepSeek-V3 judging, scoring weights, and inference prompts remain unchanged. Corrections to diagram labels and the Table 2 caption do not establish procedural changes.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate VRBench across the same eight languages, seven video categories, and seven reasoning tasks. Revised corpus counts do not establish changed domain or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains the previous models and adds MiMo-VL-7B-RL, Keye-VL-8B-Preview, and Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506. ARC-Hunyuan-Video-7B appears only in Table A3's configurations, without reported comparison results.

E3.justification: Reported corpus size changes from 1,010 videos, 9,468 questions, and 30,292 reasoning steps to 960, 8,243, and 25,106. Section 4.2 changes Qwen2.5-VL-7B's stated input from 512 to 256 frames, although Table A3 retains 128 in both versions, leaving actual settings unresolved. The evaluation design and two implemented metrics remain.

E4.justification: The long-context analysis replaces VideoChat-Flash with Kimi-VL as a comparison example and revises the associated frame counts and performance contrasts. Human-judge alignment, separate-score judging, and test-time scaling analyses retain their designs and Figure 4–5 results.

E5.justification: Human-alignment correlations, annotation-agreement statistics, and statistical reporting practices are unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Table 2 extensively replaces scores and adds three VLM result rows. The LLM outcome-accuracy leader changes from DeepSeek-R1 at 70.26 to o1-preview at 68.47; the open-source VLM overall leader changes from Qwen2.5-VL-72B at 69.23 to InternVL2.5-78B at 62.31. The revised corpus limits direct performance comparisons across versions.

T1.justification: Reasoning-type definitions, schematic reasoning chains, scoring rules, and appendix timestamp constraints remain unchanged. No theorem, proof, or substantive mathematical revision is introduced.

C1.justification: The central claims remain a novel long-narrative video benchmark, temporally grounded reasoning annotations, and combined process/outcome evaluation. Updated dataset counts, model counts, and performance gaps revise the supporting quantitative description without introducing a new central scientific claim.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning system-2 reasoning, model scale, long context, and differing LLM/VLM inputs remain substantively unchanged. The cultural-bias and ethical discussions are retained under renumbered appendix sections.

D1.justification: Table A3 adds model versions, release dates, frame budgets, and inference frameworks for Keye, Kimi, MiMo, and ARC-Hunyuan. Existing annotation instructions, inference and judging prompts, and project-access information remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds the MiMo-VL, Kimi-VL, and Kwai Keye-VL technical-report references. Table 1 changes CGBench's characterization from multilingual without clue grounding to clue-grounded without multilingual coverage. The broader research positioning remains unchanged.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized language corrections, updates affiliations, and adds a funding acknowledgement. Appendix sections F–K become G–L, while the main narrative and supplementary organization are largely retained.

P2.justification: Table 2 gains rows, sorts models by overall score within groups, and corrects its caption from three metrics to two. Table A3 expands; Figure 1 revises labels and its illustrative answer; Figure A20(b) correctly identifies the VLM prompt. Other figures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 broadens model comparisons, adds configuration details, and fixes misleading captions. However, its revised long-context discussion introduces a score/model mismatch: v1's Qwen2.5-VL-7B score of 63.06 matches Table 2, whereas v2 assigns it 61.71 despite Table 2 reporting 56.52. The PDFs also do not establish whether the extensive corpus and score revisions improve reliability. These mixed effects prevent a reliable net quality judgment.
